name: Kaiketsu! Gakuen Nandemoya
source:
Problem solved! A deep love innocence simulation game. 

There is a rumor at Seihou Academy that that if you tie a request to the sakura tree, a mysterious crab will come and undertake the request. 

That night, I saw a strange dream... flavored with desire and then sadness... 
Voices whispered from the plants and animals, awaking lost memories... 

I was able to meet an important person... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE062624.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
问题解决！一款纯真而深情的恋爱模拟游戏。

圣峰学园流传着一个传闻：只要把委托系在樱花树上，就会有一只神秘的螃蟹出现，替人完成委托。

那天夜里，我做了一个奇怪的梦…其中混杂着欲望，而后又化为悲伤…
植物与动物的低语唤醒了失落的记忆…

我终于得以与一名重要之人相见…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE062624.html]DLsite English[/url]]
